## Public Graduation Checklist (if applicable)

Only fill this section if proposing `visibility: public`.

- [ ] All content is publicly sourced or original OKHP3 content.
- [ ] No client-specific or confidential information is present.
- [ ] `manifest.yaml` updated to `visibility: public`.
- [ ] `manifest.yaml` validated against schema.
- [ ] Maintainer explicitly approves graduation in this issue.
